# Starting a compost bin

Group plants with similar water needs together so one schedule fits the whole shelf. Pinch basil above a pair of leaves and it branches into two stems instead of one. Mulch keeps the soil cool and slows evaporation during hot weeks. Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.

## Steps

- Seedlings need hardening off for a week before they live outside full time.
- Tomatoes in containers need a large pot, regular feeding and a stake before they get heavy.
- Succulents want a gritty mix with pumice or perlite so water drains within minutes.
- Compost needs a balance of green material for nitrogen and brown material for carbon.
